desc: 羊羔绒细腻亲肤、宽松慵懒不挑人、保暖又透气的秋冬针织毛衣
name: 羊羔绒宽松不臃肿针织毛衣款

shots.intent: 用居家慵懒场景加一句核心卖点，让用户 1 秒内产生『这就是我要的秋冬状态』的代入感
shots.textZone: 顶部 25%：主标题「{callout_1}」+ 字距拉开的英文小字幕行

shots.intent: 用微距绒面证明面料细腻柔软，把『摸得到的质感』变成视觉证据
shots.textZone: 上段 30%：标题「{callout_1}」+ 英文字幕行；微距区不放文字

shots.intent: 六个两字标签一行排开，快速回答『这件毛衣好在哪』，降低阅读成本
shots.textZone: 图标带下方每枚两字标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 双姿势叠排展示版型垂感与慵懒气质，让买家把衣服套到自己身上
shots.textZone: 上方标题「{callout_1}」；下部细字距英文装饰行（不承载信息）

shots.intent: 面料/颜色/尺码三栏加四行版型刻度，一次性消灭『厚不厚、紧不紧、长不长』的疑虑
shots.textZone: 标题「{callout_1}」；三栏规格标签与短值；四行刻度行标

shots.intent: 四格同机位变体阵列让颜色和男女款一目了然，缩短选款决策
shots.textZone: 每格下方两到四字款名「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 原料产地实景给面料故事一个可感知的源头画面，建立天然可信的第一层背书
shots.textZone: 下段 40%：标题「{selling_point_1}」+ 两条短材质标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用箭头示意图和纤维结构 3D 渲染把『透气又保暖』讲成看得见的原理
shots.textZone: 上段标题「{callout_1}」+ 一行副标；渲染区不放文字

shots.intent: 领口、标牌、侧边三处特写证明做工，回应『细节见品质』的质疑
shots.textZone: 每格下方加粗短标题「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」+ 一行通用说明

shots.intent: 分体型尺码表加洗护提示，在下单前消除『买多大、怎么养』的最后疑虑
shots.textZone: 标题「{callout_1}」；提示区三行洗护短句；两张表列头为尺码/胸围/衣长/肩宽等

shots.intent: 拍立得相框拼贴模拟真实买家反馈氛围，横幅只做氛围表达不写销量数字
shots.textZone: 顶部标题「{selling_point_1}」；焦糖棕横幅内为宽字距英文短语（不含数字）；相框下沿手写注记短行

style.backgroundSystem: clean cream page background #FDF8F2 with blush pink #FBEDE4 and warm beige #EDE0D4 section panels; flat, no gradients
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons in caramel brown #A97950 with two-character labels; single thin-line garment outline icon for care tips
style.lightingSystem: soft natural window light from the side for lifestyle shots, bright even high-key studio light for infographic shots, soft shadows, no harsh contrast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimalist knitwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white background #FDF8F2, blush pink section panel #FBEDE4, warm beige surface #EDE0D4, and caramel brown accent #A97950 with deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a letter-spaced uppercase English subtitle line; clean flat beige infographic panels with rounded rectangular labels and thin-line circular icons in caramel brown #A97950; soft natural window light for lifestyle shots and bright even studio light for infographic shots; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no serif or handwritten decorative type
style.presentationRules: garment shown on a generic young female model at eye level with slight 3/4 angle in lifestyle shots; straight-on flat-lay and flat graphic for infographic screens; stable scale, generous cream margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm beige paper-like panels #EDE0D4; sage green fabric sofa and white chair in lifestyle scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; deep charcoal #2D2D2D headlines with a letter-spaced uppercase English subtitle line; short two-to-four-character labels only
